The images are ready. Your workspace defines exactly one view, so there's one image:

- **`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the `SystemContext` view: Patron (person) → Library (software system), with the "Browses the catalogue through [HTTPS]" relationship, title, and C4 legend.

One transparency note on how it was produced: this sandbox has no external network access (DNS is blocked) and no local PlantUML/Java/Graphviz or SVG rasterizer, so I couldn't run a real renderer or produce a PNG. Instead I exported the view through the Structurizr MCP (both the PlantUML and C4-PlantUML definitions) and authored the SVG to match the C4-PlantUML output — standard C4 colors (`#08427B` person, `#1168BD` system), left-to-right layout, and the legend. If you open it in a browser or any SVG viewer it will display as a proper C4 system context diagram. If you'd like a PNG, it can be generated anywhere with a rasterizer (e.g. `rsvg-convert SystemContext.svg -o SystemContext.png`) once you're on a machine with network or local tooling.
